runtime-abstraction.description: Bun-specific APIs isolated behind RuntimeAdapter interface

mvi-context.description: Minimal Viable Information context system with lazy loading

inferred-verified-split.description: State split into inferred (provisional) and verified (authoritative) registries

graph-query-engine.description: Graph reasoning layer with BFS, DFS, blast radius, cycle detection over architecture graph

cache-backed-prompt-compilation.description: Prompt compiler with deterministic/inferred/speculative cache tiers and dependency-hash-based invalidation

provider-gateway.description: Whitelisted external API gateway with provider-level rate limiting and TTL-based cache

plugin-entry.description: OpenCode plugin entry point that bridges OpenCode runtime to the cognitive event system

command-registry.description: Markdown-based slash command definitions with supervisor routing

event-router.description: Priority-based event routing with tier classification (sync/async/deferred)

sync-critical.description: Synchronous, transactional state-mutating handlers for critical operations

async-background.description: Fire-and-forget async handlers for analysis and reporting

deferred-scheduled.description: Deferred handlers triggered on schedule or idle events for maintenance tasks

extensible-skills.description: Pluggable skill system with SKILL.md-based registration and discovery

cli-workflow.description: Shell script + TypeScript CLI orchestration with router.sh dispatch pattern

external-api-docs.description: Skill pattern using web search + fetch to retrieve external documentation

agent-registry.description: Centralized agent metadata registry with categories, dependencies, and cognitive budgets

configuration-loader.description: Environment variable loader with multi-path .env discovery

drift_alerts.description: Two active event handlers exist in the codebase but were completely absent from the architecture graph. The priority-router.ts routes to 'invalidate-cache' (Tier 1) and 'ecosystem-watch' (Tier 3), but neither handler node nor its edges appeared in the graph before this update.
drift_alerts.resolution: NODES ADDED to inferred graph. Edges from priority-router added. Handlers now tracked.

drift_alerts.description: Runtime abstraction pattern violation: 'invalidate-cache.ts' and 'ecosystem-watch.ts' used Node.js fs/crypto directly instead of the RuntimeAdapter interface.
drift_alerts.resolution: RESOLVED on 2026-05-12: RuntimeAdapter extended with filesystem methods (fileExists, readTextFile, writeTextFile, deleteFile, ensureDirectory, hashString). Both handlers refactored to use adapter instead of direct fs/crypto calls.
